about.text: A soft, mild, unripened cheese made from cream, or milk with cream, soured by lactic bacteria and drained; the US standard demands at least 33 % milk fat and at most 55 % moisture.

picks.why: The world's best-known cream cheese brand, made since 1872 and the defining American cream cheese.
The American cream cheese itself, the dominant form of the type, eaten on bagels and used in cheesecake worldwide.
French herb-and-garlic cream cheese, sold internationally and the best-known flavoured cream cheese in Europe.
The American reduced-fat cream cheese, the original Neufchâtel-style product from which Philadelphia itself grew.
Scotland's ancient cream cheese, made from double cream and rolled in oatmeal, among the oldest named cream cheeses.
